prose.summary: Reconciled source purposes: [1] Define GUI Editor for operational/control surfaces bound to canonical operations, REST/OSC/protocol controls and runtime-state views, distinct from structured data-entry Form semantics. [2] Define GUI Editor for operational controls and live control surfaces over canonical operations such as REST/OSC-driven controls, separate from structured data-entry forms.

semantics.authority_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Control visibility/enabled state is projection only; actual enforcement remains canonical. [2] Visible/enabled control does not bypass AccessCore.
semantics.binding_rule: Control target, direction and schema are explicit.
semantics.control_rule: Each UI control binds to an explicit canonical operation/state source.
semantics.form_boundary: GUI Editor is not the primary data-entry schema/form editor.
semantics.form_rule: Structured record/data entry belongs to Form Editor unless a control explicitly owns simple scalar input.
semantics.protocol_rule: REST/OSC bindings are transport surfaces; GUI semantics reference operations rather than transport implementation details.
semantics.role: Reconciled source clauses: [1] operational/control editor [2] operational controls / live interaction
semantics.runtime_rule: GUI Editor may expose runtime state and controls but does not own their semantics.
semantics.source_rule: Controls bind to explicit canonical operations, states or protocol-exposed surfaces.
semantics.state_rule: Transient widget state is presentation state unless explicitly bound to canonical/runtime state.
semantics.write_rule: Control actions invoke canonical operations; no private backend mutation.
